column1: # MailDeck mailbox export — SAMPLE / TEMPLATE (safe to commit; contains NO real creds)
# When you export the 30 SMTP/IMAP creds from MailDeck (Sidebar → Exports / SMTP)
# save the file as: config/maildeck-mailboxes.csv   (that real file is gitignored)
# then run:  node scripts/load-maildeck-creds.js
# The loader is tolerant of MailDeck's exact column names. It will recognise common
# aliases (email/address/username
# etc.). At minimum it needs: an email/address column and a password column.
# COLUMN NOTES
#   address           the lookalike from-address (cold only). MUST be a lookalike domain
#                     (tamazia.uk/.store/.info/.online
#                     real brand domain (tamazia.co.uk / tamazia.in). The loader refuses real domains.
#   persona_name      display name shown to recipients (keep consistent per inbox for reputation)
#   smtp_host/port    usually smtp.gmail.com / 587 for Google Workspace inboxes
#   smtp_pass         the app password / SMTP password from MailDeck
#   imap_host/port    usually imap.gmail.com / 993 (used later for per-inbox reply reads if needed)
#   added_at          (optional) ISO date the inbox started warmup. If blank
#                     as the ramp clock start. Leave blank unless you know the real warmup-start date.
address
john@tamazia.uk
sara@tamazia.store
